review.en: A gay man in Taipei, after the death of his closest friend, writes notes on love, desire, cities and mortality. Chu T'ien-wen packs the book with quotations, colours and fragments of theory, a dense and deliberately mannered style. Demanding and sometimes airless, it is also one of the most daring Chinese novels of the 1990s, and won the first China Times novel prize.
review.zh: 台北的一位男同志，在挚友死后写下手记，谈爱欲、城市、肉身与死亡。朱天文把引文、色彩和理论碎片密密地织进书里，文体刻意而繁复。读来吃力，有时令人窒息，却是九十年代最大胆的中文小说之一，获首届时报文学百万小说奖。
